panels.description: In a civic archive, Leona stands among quiet records as Ada stops several steps away. Leave upper archive space.
Leona opens a stone-grey box containing a sage-gold Covenant band and old photographs. Leave upper table space.
Leona looks at the child's object in the box while Ada remains rigid across from her. Leave upper archive space.
Ada faces Leona directly; the distance between them remains visible. Leave upper space.

items.speaker: LEONA
items.text: I knew where you were within a year.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Then you knew enough to come.

items.speaker: LEONA
items.text: I believed you were safer not knowing I was looking.
